      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Fixes a dangerous CLI footgun where trailing options like -rpcwallet were silently ignored after command arguments, potentially directing operations to the wrong wallet. Updating bitcoin-cli to recognize options after non-option arguments directly improves CLI correctness and user safety."

      "rationale": "Adapts bitcoin-tx to consume pre-filtered arguments from ArgsManager, allowing GNU-style option placement in the utility. This is a minor ergonomics improvement to an auxiliary tool."
    },

      "name": "utils",

      "evidence": "src/common/args.cpp, src/test/argsman_tests.cpp",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.6,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Resolves confusing and silent option-swallowing behavior across the shared ArgsManager. Unrecognized trailing options now raise errors instead of being treated as positional values, directly addressing confusing configuration options within shared argument handling."
